# David Silverlight Portfolio

> David Silverlight is a senior .NET MAUI and Xamarin.Forms developer specializing in enterprise mobile apps, Xamarin-to-.NET MAUI migrations, healthcare, GIS, logistics, fintech, IoT, and mobile performance work.

David is based in Miami, Florida and is available for senior mobile development, consulting, modernization, migration, and project rescue work.

## Key Pages

- [Portfolio Home](https://davidsilverlight.github.io/Portfolio/): Overview of David Silverlight's mobile, web, Silverlight, Xamarin.Forms, and .NET MAUI work.
- [RamTech gMobile Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.github.io/Portfolio/RamTech%20gMobile.html): .NET MAUI Esri/ArcGIS field-inspection app for damage assessment, leak survey, and gas-insight inspections.
- [ATrack Mobile Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.github.io/Portfolio/ATrack%20Mobile.html): .NET MAUI clinical data-collection platform for ABA therapy providers.
- [UPS Mobile Delivery Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.github.io/Portfolio/UPS%20Mobile%20Delivery.html): .NET MAUI feasibility and component work for enterprise delivery handhelds.
- [BCBS My BluePrint Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.github.io/Portfolio/BCBS%20-%20My%20BluePrint.html): Healthcare member app (claims, benefits, contact) built with Xamarin.Forms.
- [T-Mobile Money Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.github.io/Portfolio/T-Mobile%20Money.html): Fintech mobile banking app built with Xamarin.Forms.
- [UAS Trakker Case Study](https://davidsilverlight.github.io/Portfolio/UAS%20Trakker.html): GIS/drone search-and-rescue mapping app.
- [Resume](https://davidsilverlight.github.io/Portfolio/David%20Silverlight%20Resume.html): David Silverlight's resume.
